name: ecr
description: Amazon Elastic Container Registry Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) is a managed container image registry service.

subcommands.name: batch-check-layer-availability
subcommands.description: Checks the availability of one or more image layers in a repository.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-image
subcommands.description: Deletes a list of specified images within a repository.

subcommands.name: batch-get-image
subcommands.description: Gets detailed information for an image.

subcommands.name: batch-get-repository-scanning-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the scanning configuration for one or more repositories.

subcommands.name: complete-layer-upload
subcommands.description: Informs Amazon ECR that the image layer upload has completed for a specified registry, repository name, and upload ID.

subcommands.name: create-pull-through-cache-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a pull through cache rule.

subcommands.name: create-repository
subcommands.description: Creates a repository.

subcommands.name: create-repository-creation-template
subcommands.description: Creates a repository creation template.

subcommands.name: delete-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the lifecycle policy associated with the specified repository.

subcommands.name: delete-pull-through-cache-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a pull through cache rule.

subcommands.name: delete-registry-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the registry permissions policy.

subcommands.name: delete-repository
subcommands.description: Deletes a repository.

subcommands.name: delete-repository-creation-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a repository creation template.

subcommands.name: delete-repository-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the repository policy associated with the specified repository.

subcommands.name: delete-signing-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the registry's signing configuration.

subcommands.name: deregister-pull-time-update-exclusion
subcommands.description: Removes a principal from the pull time update exclusion list for a registry.

subcommands.name: describe-image-replication-status
subcommands.description: Returns the replication status for a specified image.

subcommands.name: describe-image-scan-findings
subcommands.description: Returns the scan findings for the specified image.

subcommands.name: describe-image-signing-status
subcommands.description: Returns the signing status for a specified image.

subcommands.name: describe-images
subcommands.description: Returns metadata about the images in a repository.

subcommands.name: describe-pull-through-cache-rules
subcommands.description: Returns the pull through cache rules for a registry.

subcommands.name: describe-registry
subcommands.description: Describes the settings for a registry.

subcommands.name: describe-repositories
subcommands.description: Describes image repositories in a registry.

subcommands.name: describe-repository-creation-templates
subcommands.description: Returns details about the repository creation templates in a registry.

subcommands.name: get-account-setting
subcommands.description: Retrieves the account setting value for the specified setting name.

subcommands.name: get-authorization-token
subcommands.description: Retrieves an authorization token.

subcommands.name: get-download-url-for-layer
subcommands.description: Retrieves the pre-signed Amazon S3 download URL corresponding to an image layer.

subcommands.name: get-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the lifecycle policy for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: get-lifecycle-policy-preview
subcommands.description: Retrieves the results of the lifecycle policy preview request for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: get-registry-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the permissions policy for a registry.

subcommands.name: get-registry-scanning-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the scanning configuration for a registry.

subcommands.name: get-repository-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the repository policy for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: get-signing-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the registry's signing configuration, which defines rules for automatically signing images using Amazon Web Services Signer.

subcommands.name: initiate-layer-upload
subcommands.description: Notifies Amazon ECR that you intend to upload an image layer.

subcommands.name: list-image-referrers
subcommands.description: Lists the artifacts associated with a specified subject image.

subcommands.name: list-images
subcommands.description: Lists all the image IDs for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: list-pull-time-update-exclusions
subcommands.description: Lists the IAM principals that are excluded from having their image pull times recorded.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List the tags for an Amazon ECR resource.

subcommands.name: put-account-setting
subcommands.description: Allows you to change the basic scan type version or registry policy scope.

subcommands.name: put-image
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the image manifest and tags associated with an image.

subcommands.name: put-image-scanning-configuration
subcommands.description: The PutImageScanningConfiguration API is being deprecated, in favor of specifying the image scanning configuration at the registry level.

subcommands.name: put-image-tag-mutability
subcommands.description: Updates the image tag mutability settings for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: put-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the lifecycle policy for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: put-registry-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the permissions policy for your registry.

subcommands.name: put-registry-scanning-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the scanning configuration for your private registry.

subcommands.name: put-replication-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the replication configuration for a registry.

subcommands.name: put-signing-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the registry's signing configuration, which defines rules for automatically signing images with Amazon Web Services Signer.

subcommands.name: register-pull-time-update-exclusion
subcommands.description: Adds an IAM principal to the pull time update exclusion list for a registry.

subcommands.name: set-repository-policy
subcommands.description: Applies a repository policy to the specified repository to control access permissions.

subcommands.name: start-image-scan
subcommands.description: Starts a basic image vulnerability scan.

subcommands.name: start-lifecycle-policy-preview
subcommands.description: Starts a preview of a lifecycle policy for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds specified tags to a resource with the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes specified tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-image-storage-class
subcommands.description: Transitions an image between storage classes.

subcommands.name: update-pull-through-cache-rule
subcommands.description: Updates an existing pull through cache rule.

subcommands.name: update-repository-creation-template
subcommands.description: Updates an existing repository creation template.

subcommands.name: upload-layer-part
subcommands.description: Uploads an image layer part to Amazon ECR.

subcommands.name: validate-pull-through-cache-rule
subcommands.description: Validates an existing pull through cache rule for an upstream registry that requires authentication.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: image-scan-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until an image scan is complete and findings can be accessed It will poll every 5 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: lifecycle-policy-preview-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until a lifecycle policy preview request is complete and results can be accessed It will poll every 5 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
